name: Barbell Reverse Lunge
cues: Set the bar across your upper back
Step back far enough that your front shin stays near vertical
Lower your back knee toward the floor
Drive through your front foot to step back in

qa.note: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated ok by the lane review, auto-approved. ok: Back foot steps 0.90 m back, the front foot is planted (slip 0.2 mm), front knee 3 to 100, rear knee to 102, rear hip -5 to 1 at the bottom. Trunk 9 to 23 deg, peaking during the step, same as the approved 409. The bar sits on the high-bar site at 1.52 m and follows the trunk.
